obligations.name: AOC-4 — Financial Statements
obligations.description: File the audited financial statements with the ROC within 30 days of the AGM.

obligations.name: MGT-7 — Annual Return
obligations.description: File the annual return with the ROC within 60 days of the AGM.

obligations.name: ADT-1 — Auditor Appointment
obligations.description: Intimate the ROC of an auditor appointment/ratification within 15 days of the AGM.

obligations.name: DIR-3 KYC — Director KYC
obligations.authority: Companies (Appt. & Qual. of Directors) Rules, r.12A
obligations.description: Every DIN holder must file KYC by 30 September each year.

obligations.name: DPT-3 — Return of Deposits
obligations.description: Annual return of deposits and outstanding non-deposit money as on 31 March.

obligations.name: MSME-1 — Dues to MSME suppliers
obligations.description: Half-yearly return of outstanding payments to MSME vendors pending beyond 45 days.

obligations.name: CSR-2 — CSR Report
obligations.description: Report on CSR spending (filed as an addendum to AOC-4).

obligations.name: Annual General Meeting
obligations.description: Hold the AGM within 6 months of the financial-year end (by 30 September).

obligations.name: Board Meeting
obligations.description: Hold a board meeting — minimum 4 per year with a gap of no more than 120 days.

obligations.name: Advance Tax — 1st instalment (15%)
obligations.description: Pay 15% of the estimated annual tax by 15 June.

obligations.name: Advance Tax — 2nd instalment (45%)
obligations.description: Cumulative 45% of the estimated annual tax by 15 September.

obligations.name: Advance Tax — 3rd instalment (75%)
obligations.description: Cumulative 75% of the estimated annual tax by 15 December.

obligations.name: Advance Tax — 4th instalment (100%)
obligations.description: Cumulative 100% of the estimated annual tax by 15 March.

obligations.name: Tax Audit Report (3CA/3CB-3CD)
obligations.description: File the tax audit report by 30 September.

obligations.name: Income Tax Return (ITR-6)
obligations.description: File the company income tax return by 31 October (audit cases).

obligations.name: Form 3CEB — Transfer Pricing
obligations.description: Accountant's report on international / specified domestic transactions.

obligations.name: TDS Payment

4.note: TDS deducted in March is due 30 April.

obligations.description: Deposit TDS by the 7th of the following month (March deductions by 30 April).

obligations.name: TDS Return (24Q / 26Q / 27Q)
obligations.description: File the quarterly TDS statement (Q4 is due 31 May).

obligations.name: GSTR-1 — Outward Supplies
obligations.description: Monthly statement of outward supplies by the 11th (QRMP filers: 13th of the month after the quarter).

obligations.name: GSTR-3B — Summary Return
obligations.description: Monthly summary return and tax payment by the 20th.

obligations.name: GSTR-9 / 9C — Annual Return
obligations.description: Annual GST return (9C reconciliation if turnover exceeds ₹5 crore).

obligations.name: EPF — ECR & Contribution
obligations.description: Upload the ECR and pay the EPF contribution by the 15th.

obligations.name: ESI — Contribution
obligations.description: Pay the ESI contribution by the 15th.

obligations.name: Professional Tax
obligations.description: Deposit Professional Tax (due date and rates vary by state).

obligations.name: POSH — Annual Report
obligations.description: Internal Committee files its annual report with the District Officer (required at 10+ employees).

obligations.name: Financial Results
obligations.description: Quarterly results within 45 days of quarter-end (annual within 60 days).

obligations.name: Shareholding Pattern
obligations.description: File the shareholding pattern within 21 days of quarter-end.

obligations.name: Corporate Governance Report
obligations.description: File the corporate governance report within 21 days of quarter-end.

obligations.name: FLA Return
obligations.description: Annual Foreign Liabilities & Assets return (position as on 31 March).

obligations.name: APR — Overseas Investment
obligations.description: Annual Performance Report for overseas direct investment.
